payloads.content:

Nasal medicine (MFDS 200410068)Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 200410068. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of dryness of the nasal mucosa.

At a glance

Category

Over-the-counter medicine · Nasal medicine

How it works

This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of dryness of the nasal mucosa.

Why this one

Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 200410068. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

How to use it in the nose

For children under 2 years of age, spray once into each nostril. For children 2 years of age and older, spray 1 to 2 times into each nostril, 2 to 4 times a day or whenever needed.

Precautions for use

  • Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to benzalkonium chloride.
  • Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms related to nasal drops (for example, rash, redness, swelling, or a stinging sensation), or if you have recently had nose surgery or have bodily changes caused by illness.
  • Use this medicine only as a nasal drop.
  • For hygiene, one product should be used by only one person.

This leaflet supports in-store consultation. Ask a pharmacist at the store about product choice and use. Products with the same ingredient, strength and form are managed to the same quality standard. Check by ingredient and strength rather than by product name.

payloads.content:

Rectal medicine (MFDS 202002671)Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 202002671. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

This medicine is used for the temporary relief of the pain, itching, swelling and bleeding of anal fissure and hemorrhoids.

At a glance

Category

Over-the-counter medicine · Rectal medicine

How it works

This medicine is used for the temporary relief of the pain, itching, swelling and bleeding of anal fissure and hemorrhoi

Why this one

Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 202002671. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

How to use it in the rectum

For adults and those 15 years of age and older, insert 1 piece into the rectum at a time, within the range of 3 times a day.

Precautions for use

  • Do not use this medicine if you have heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate.
  • Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
  • If your symptoms do not improve after about 7 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
  • Do not use it in children.
  • Use this medicine only in the rectum and do not use it orally.
  • If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has become too hard, soften it before use.
  • Follow the prescribed directions and dosage carefully.

Possible side effects

  • If edema (swelling), a feeling of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congestion causing reddening, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Interactions

  • Do not use this medicine together with suppositories, ointments or creams containing dl-methylephedrine hydrochloride, scopolia extract or glycyrrhizic acid, with antihypertensive medicines, or with antidepressants.

This leaflet supports in-store consultation. Ask a pharmacist at the store about product choice and use. Products with the same ingredient, strength and form are managed to the same quality standard. Check by ingredient and strength rather than by product name.

This medicine is used for nasal cavity irrigation for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucous discharge or purulent (suppurative) conditions.

At a glance

Category

Over-the-counter medicine · Nasal medicine

How it works

This medicine is used for nasal cavity irrigation for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucous discharge or purulent (suppur

Why this one

Based on the official MFDS approval for product code 200108738. Check the ingredient and strength rather than the product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

How to use it in the nose

Use the spray nozzle for infants aged 1 to 24 months and the jet nozzle for children 6 years of age and older and for adults, spraying 2 times into each nasal cavity in the morning and in the evening. To keep the solution from running down into the larynx or pharynx, lie on your side at an angle or stand with your head tilted while using it.

Warning

  • The jet nozzle has a strong spray pressure, so when it is used in infants and young children there is a risk that the solution may enter the wrong place or that laryngeal spasm may occur.

Precautions for use

  • Do not use the spray nozzle in infants under 1 month of age.
  • Do not use the jet nozzle in infants and young children under 6 years of age.
  • If several people share it, an infection may be spread.

Possible side effects

  • If the nose is inflamed, a temporary stinging sensation and similar effects may occur.
  • If the stinging persists, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

This leaflet supports in-store consultation. Ask a pharmacist at the store about product choice and use. Products with the same ingredient, strength and form are managed to the same quality standard. Check by ingredient and strength rather than by product name.

Who should ask first

If any item in the safety information applies to you, ask the pharmacist at the store first.

When needed, spray every 2 to 3 hours: adults 1 to 8 times, newborn infants 1 time, infants 1 to 12 months of age 1 to 2 times, children 1 to 2 years of age 1 to 3 times, children 2 to 5 years of age 1 to 4 times, children 5 to 8 years of age 1 to 5 times, and children 8 to 12 years of age 1 to 6 times.
